notes:
Account summary: AmberGlow is a mid-market CX SaaS provider (helpdesk + knowledge base + in-app assistant). They want to start with Redwood's Hosted API for fast time-to-value in EU, then evaluate Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable latency/cost as traffic grows. Key constraints: EU data residency (GDPR), ability to route EU traffic to EU-only endpoints, SSO for internal admin UI, and audit logs for compliance.

Latest feedback from CTO Elena: "We cannot have PII or EU customer transcripts leave the EU region — even temporary caching in US is a no-go." She also noted latency expectations: p95 < 300ms for short chat turns and single-digit-second for long-context summarization jobs. Cost sensitivity: wants committed pricing for Dedicated if unit price delta vs hosted justifies migration.

Technical notes from SE Liam: tried hosted eu-west instance — avg latency 180ms p50 for 512-token chat prompt but p95 spikes to ~420ms under burst. Discussed multi-region routing options: primary EU region + fallback to other regions on capacity; AmberGlow's legal team prefers fallback only to other EU regions (no cross-border fallback). We flagged implications: higher cold-start and buffer capacity if strict intra-EU-only fallbacks, potential cost increase.

POC plan (agreed in principle): 4-week POC using Hosted API in eu-west for feature parity + synthetic load tests, parallel Dedicated sizing exercise (performance and cost modeling). Deliverables: latency/throughput report, cost-per-1000-turns, data residency attestation, and SSO integration checklist.

Sales/ops: pricing ask — committed Dedicated 8 GPU-equivalent pool estimate + burst policy; need legal addendum for data residency SLA. Next steps are to finalize SOW, get legal sign-off, and schedule Dedicated sizing call with infra architects.
